name: JTAL Flashcards
description: Chrome extension for Just Take a Lesson - add flashcards from any webpage

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src https://justtakealesson.pl https://*.justtakealesson.pl https://www.gravatar.com; img-src 'self' data: https://www.gravatar.com https://justtakealesson.pl; object-src 'none';
